about: What each provider slot has recorded against the real service (router design section 11, release gate; lane E2-R3b). tools/release_gate/check_router_release.py reads it with tools/model_caps/models.toml: a slot marked releasable fails while a synthetic wire fixture is left for it or a request-shape feature its rows allow has no recorded 2xx. A citation is a repo path or 'P:<path>' (a program evidence file outside the repo). A waiver names an item and why it is accepted; the gate prints every waiver and fails on one that no longer matches anything. R10 (design section 12) replaces waivers with recordings.
